status: local working-tree optimization evidence; final revision and CI belong to the PR receipt

productionChanges.addressIndices: Generated street mouths, parts and court addresses are indexed once. Visible queries return the same original objects in the original painter order; courts retain their own ground addresses.
productionChanges.terrainMemo: One draw creates an exact-coordinate height sampler shared by the front and rear cameras. It caches at most 1024 unique samples by default, with a hard allowed maximum of 4096. There is no coordinate rounding, cross-frame cache, timer or new Canvas/context.

unchanged: serialized world geometry, parcel graph and artwork contacts
source object identities and original painter ordering
front/rear image keys, order, projection arguments and filter values
native production vector and HUD pixels while image submissions are traced
exact height outputs and bounded per-frame cache
focusedCheck.fixtureLimits: The two boss frames use a production committed attack and persistent rig body, with staged presentation timers. They are rendering diagnostics, not earned gameplay or a human playtest. Atlas source submissions are traced; this check does not inspect every source-art pixel.
focusedCheck.ciHistoryRequirement: none; default comparison uses the current production renderer and switches only the reference layout queries/memo to full scans/zero caching

historicalAudit.meaning: The PR167 production renderer with only indexed queries/shared exact height sampling substituted preserved geometry, image submission arguments/order and native vector/HUD pixels. This optional audit requires the named Git history.

profiling.limits: Native CPU timing varies substantially with host load and decode. A first draw uses predecoded images and is not cold network loading. The paint stage also includes traffic, car, rearview and HUD. Operation reductions do not establish browser FPS, total frame-time improvement, Makko performance, physical-controller comfort or owner acceptance. Final sequential same-host timing remains separate.
